verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Sentry ingests OpenTelemetry traces and logs, offers a Trace Explorer for span samples and attributes, and lets Seer draw on tracing data and logs. None of it documents navigating from a specific span to its correlated logs and metrics, and metrics correlation is not mentioned at all. These are adjacent capabilities, not the span-to-logs/metrics pivot the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump from a trace span to its correlated logs and metrics to debug a request end to end
